sentences.en: The train will go through the running tunnel in five minutes.
sentences.zh: 火车五分钟后会经过那个行车隧道。

sentences.en: There's a long running tunnel connecting both sides of the mountain.
sentences.zh: 有一条长长的行车隧道连接着山的两边。

sentences.en: The construction of the new running tunnel has been completed.
sentences.zh: 新建成的那个行车隧道已经完工了。

senses.zh: (海底隧道系统中互相平行的) 直行通道
